text:
Lena (People Ops): Quick heads-up — reviewer coverage sheet is live. We need 2 extra float reviewers for next Wed/Thu for EMEA windows. Link: https://tiny.redwood/review-coverage :eyes:
Anya (People Ops): On it — I can cover Wed afternoon EMEA (14:00-18:00 UTC) and Thu morning PST. I'll add to the sheet.
Matt P: I can take Thu 16:00-20:00 UTC. What's the expected throughput? Rough estimate of reviews/hour?
Lena (People Ops): Thanks! Aim is ~6-8 handbacks/hr per reviewer for short-form tracks, 3-4/hr for deep dives. We'll batch 2 deep dives per slot.
Jia: If anyone needs a quick refresher, here's the reviewer binder template I updated: /docs/review/binder-v3.md. TL;DR: use the 'evidence-first' rubric and add short examples.
Sam (Eng): Can we get a canned message for manager exceptions? I have a lead on LOA coverage and want to confirm flow.
Lena (People Ops): Good call — paste this to managers for exceptions: "If a reviewer is on LOA, assign backup and flag in the sheet; escalate to people-ops@redwood by EOD prior to slot." I'll drop a copy in the sheet.
Anya (People Ops): Added a new column 'Backup Reviewer' and 'Escalation POC'. Also added a link to the sample eval CSV template and a quick import command:
```
# CSV header for bulk uploads
reviewer,slot_start_utc,slot_end_utc,track,backup_reviewer
anya,2024-11-06T14:00Z,2024-11-06T18:00Z,short,jia
```
Matt P: Perfect. Is there a way to subscribe to slot reminders? I keep missing calendar invites.
review-bot: Reminder subscribed — you'll get DM 1h before your slot. Use `subscribe slot 2170` to manage.
Jia: One more ask — please add an 'eval-priority' flag for candidates with outstanding follow-ups so reviewers know to escalate.
Lena (People Ops): Added 'eval-priority' and a tiny policy note: high-priority = respond within 24h. Folks, if you can't cover your slot, please swap on the sheet or @people-ops and we'll backfill.
Sam (Eng): 👍 I swapped my slot with Matt in the sheet. Thanks all.
Lena (People Ops): Closing loop — I'll thread a short email to managers with the exception flow and will ping again tomorrow morning to confirm EMEA coverage. :ballot_box_with_check:
